name: What are common kitchen layouts, and how do I choose the best one for my home?

mainEntity.name: What are common kitchen layouts, and how do I choose the best one for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common kitchen layouts include the L-shaped, U-shaped, galley, and single-wall designs, often combined with an island. Choosing the best layout depends on your home's architecture, available space, lifestyle, and cooking habits. An L-shaped or U-shaped kitchen offers ample counter and storage space, suitable for larger families. Galley kitchens are efficient for smaller spaces, while a single-wall layout works well in open-concept homes. Our designers can help evaluate your needs and space to recommend the most functional and aesthetically pleasing option.
